name: BTF Small Grants Window

funder.name: Bhutan Trust Fund for Environmental Conservation (BTFEC)

summary: Rolling small grants in Bhutan for community-based environmental initiatives covering climate resilience, sustainable livelihoods and biodiversity conservation, reviewed every quarter.
reporting: Periodic reporting and compliance reviews are mandatory, and the final 20% of the grant is released on a completion report with invoices.

status.quote: The Small Grants Window remains open throughout the year, and applicants may submit proposals at any time

applicant_types.quote: Government agencies, CSOs, CBOs, academic institutions, youth groups, private sector entities, and individuals.

geography.quote: supports environmental conservation, climate resilience, and sustainable development in Bhutan

access.quote: applicants may submit proposals at any time using the prescribed Small Grant Proposal Template

window.quote: The Small Grants Window remains open throughout the year, and applicants may submit proposals at any time

amount.quote: Up to Nu. 1.0 million per project

reporting.quote: Periodic reporting and compliance reviews are mandatory for all funding windows
